snippet.title: BrokenLore: MIKI-CHAN | Harvest of Terror: Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Broken Lore: MIKI-CHAN is coming to PC and consoles.

First introduced in BrokenLore: DON’T LIE, Miki-chan now takes center stage in her own first-person psychological horror game.

Set inside a Japanese school, you’ll face Miki-chan, a virtual AI assistant who becomes increasingly jealous, possessive, and obsessive.

Explore a distorted school simulation, use the Rewriter to alter reality, survive Miki-chan’s obsession, and uncover a new piece of the mystery behind the interconnected world of BrokenLore.

Coming in 2027 to PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
